$comment: Adapter baseline for cypress. Policy that is identical for every cypress project. Composed with a project profile to produce that project's harness.config.json. Edit policy here once; every project on this adapter inherits it.

rules.why: A fixed wait masks the real timing bug and fails on slower CI machines.
rules.message: Hard wait detected. Replace with cy.apiWait(...) or a deterministic state-based wait.

rules.never: a selector literal in a spec or command
rules.why: One app change should mean one config edit, not a hunt through 50 specs.
rules.message: Hardcoded selector. Use config constants from cypress/configs/ui/**.

rules.why: Routes change; a central registry keeps every caller correct.
rules.message: Hardcoded route. Use route constants from cypress/configs/app/routes.js.

rules.why: Commands are the page methods; a second abstraction layer duplicates ownership.
rules.message: Action class or page-object import. Command-first architecture forbids these dependencies.

rules.never: an auth-required spec without an auth call
rules.instead: cy.ensureAuthenticated() in beforeEach(), or the module's own auth command plus the // @no-ensureAuthenticated pragma
rules.why: Session setup belongs in one place, not repeated per test.
rules.message: Missing cy.ensureAuthenticated() in auth-required test file.

rules.never: a password, secret, API key or token assigned a literal string
rules.instead: cy.env([...]) reading cypress.env.json (gitignored) or a CI secret
rules.why: Trust boundary. A committed credential is a breach, not a style issue.
rules.message: Hardcoded credential. Read it with cy.env([...]) instead.

rules.instead: read-only assertions; put mutations in the e2e tier
rules.why: Smoke runs against shared and production-like environments.
rules.message: Write request in smoke suite. Smoke tests must remain read-only.

rules.never: a new config, command or spec without searching first
rules.instead: grep the literal selector/endpoint/route across configs and commands — search by value, not filename
rules.why: A filename check that finds nothing is not a value check that finds nothing. Duplicate owners are the most common review failure.
rules.message: Search cypress/configs/** and cypress/support/commands/** by value before creating a new one.

rules.never: a spec with no requirement tag, or more than one
rules.instead: exactly one known requirement id in the title and as a tag, plus Type, Priority, and tier tags
rules.why: The title survives every reporter and the tag supports filtering; together they make coverage computable.
rules.message: Spec must carry exactly one known requirement id in its title and tags.

agents.name: project-bootstrapper
agents.description: Derive an approved project and application contract from verified sources before any test generation.
agents.when: Start a new project or module from no existing automation context

agents.name: cypress-discovery
agents.description: Capture verified selectors, routes, and flow steps from the running application into config constants.
agents.when: Observe an unknown module and turn what you see into config constants

agents.name: cypress-generator
agents.description: Turns a requirement into a merge-ready Cypress module — UI config, routes, API config, commands, registration, and the spec.
agents.when: Build a module from a requirement id — config → commands → spec

agents.name: cypress-bug-hunter
agents.description: Debug a failing smoke test, trace root cause, and propose an exact compliant fix.

agents.name: pre-merge-qa-gate
agents.description: Evaluate supplied change and command evidence through the 6-phase QA gate and return PASS, PASS_WITH_ACTIONS, or BLOCK.
agents.when: Evaluate supplied diff and verification evidence — PASS / PASS_WITH_ACTIONS / BLOCK
agents.readOnlyRationale: Read/search only by design: the gate cannot edit files or execute shell commands, so the builder never grades its own output.

agents.name: pr-creator
agents.description: Create a pull request with the repository's standard generated description.
agents.when: Opening a pull request with a generated description

agents.name: workflow-maintainer
agents.description: Simplify repository workflow scripts, agents, and docs without duplicating ownership.
agents.when: Simplify workflow scripts, agents, or docs
